name: Bo-Katan Kryze
bannerMiniatureIdeas: Mythosaur skull totem mounted on a Mandalorian standard, etched with the Nite Owl visor sigil and House Kryze markings
The Darksaber planted blade-first in cracked Mandalorian soil beside a Nite Owl helmet crest
Crossed WESTAR-35 blaster carbines flanking a jetpack wing motif on a Death Watch battle pennant
vehicleSuggestions: Kom'rk-class fighter/transport (Gauntlet) — Death Watch assault dropship used in Nite Owl strike raids
Fang-class starfighter — Mandalorian resistance strike craft from the Siege of Mandalore era
Mandalorian speeder bike — rapid-deployment cavalry Bo-Katan fielded against Maul's super commandos

factionTrait.name: Marauders Champion
factionTrait.text: A marauder moves the turn token +1 step when they knock out an enemy follower.

uniqueTraits.name: Nite Owl Command
uniqueTraits.text: When Bo-Katan Kryze knocks out an enemy follower, move a friendly model within 3 hexes of her up to 1 hex. Each model may only be moved once per activation using this trait.

ultimate.name: Tactical Redeploy
ultimate.text: Move another model within range up to 3 hexes.

plotSkills.name: Owl Flight Formation
plotSkills.text: Followers within range move up to 2 hexes.

plotSkills.name: Jetpack Charge
plotSkills.text: Hit Effect: Bo-Katan Kryze moves up to 2 hexes towards the target.

clashSkills.name: Crossfire Assault
clashSkills.text: Target up to 3 models in a single hex. This skill has +1 {damage_die} for each hex adjacent to the target that contains one or more friendly followers.

clashSkills.name: Nite Owl Volley
clashSkills.text: This skill may target up to 2 followers within range. This skill has +1 {damage_die} for each hex adjacent to the target that contains one or more friendly followers.

traits.name: Owls to Prey
traits.text: When a Nite Owl uses a skill targeting a small follower it gains +3 {accuracy_die} if there are more followers in the Nite Owl's hex than in the target's hex.

plotSkills.name: Encirclement Maneuver
plotSkills.text: Hit Effect: Place each Nite Owl within range of the target in a hex adjacent to the target.

clashSkills.name: Repulsor Push
clashSkills.text: Hit Effect: Move each follower model in the target's hex up to 1 hex.

clashSkills.name: Flanking Strike
clashSkills.text: Hit Effect: Move a Nite Owl up to 1 hex.
